citations.purpose: cells allocated inside the pairwise branch; the win list and loss list start empty per cell.
Training-unit key = (truncated pairId, turn bucket); turnBucket is built before standardization at line 343.
Each training sample is appended to the cell's winning list (y[r] > 0.5) or losing list.
Usable pair-cell count = cells where both the winning and losing lists are non-empty; computed at line 503 and only printed at lines 504-505.
used counter reset to 0 at the start of every epoch; incremented only by completed pair samples.
Pair sampling walks the shuffled training index array in steps of 2 (adjacent pairs) up to nTrain-1.
Cell lookup for the sample at the even position; null-forgiving on cells because the pairwise branch guarantees allocation.
Partner pool is the opposite-label list of the same cell (L when y[ri] > 0.5, W otherwise).
Skip: when the opposite-label pool is empty the iteration continues without forward, loss, backward or used increment.
used incremented once per actually sampled pair (after loss and BackwardFrom calls at lines 551-554).
Per-epoch step scale = lr divided by max(1, used); shared by all three weight updates.
